objective: Build the first executable source-subset manifest and replay contract for the operational astronomical data platform.

baseline.description: P0 recovery work is merged to main. The repository already has dataset/reproducibility primitives, but P1 lacks a dedicated source-subset manifest and replay-verification contract.

correctness.reason: P1 implementation and regression tests have not yet executed in CI.

reliability.reason: P1 implementation and CI validation are pending.

reproducibility.reason: Replay verification is the objective of this stage and has not yet been measured.

scientific_validity.reason: P1 source-subset replay semantics must be validated before this metric is measured.

measurement.trade_off: No source semantics, temporal cutoff, checksum requirement, or provenance requirement is weakened.

findings: Source acquisition provenance must be represented separately from model/feature reproducibility metadata.
Replay must verify immutable artifact hashes and the declared temporal/source contract rather than merely re-running code.

open_blockers: P1 source-subset manifest and replay verification tests are not yet implemented.
